summary: Check Point’s browser extension: it protects people on the web on managed and personal devices, as an extra layer on top of endpoint protection.
value: Fresh phishing sites are blocked, and corporate passwords are not entered on third-party sites.
Malicious and unwanted sites do not open.
Downloaded files are checked in a sandbox, and the user immediately gets a sanitised copy.
simple: A browser extension that protects people on the web on managed and personal devices — an extra layer on top of endpoint protection. Blocks phishing sites, including new ones (Zero-Phishing), malicious sites and unwanted categories (URL Filtering), stops corporate passwords from being entered on third-party sites, and checks downloaded files in a sandbox while immediately delivering a sanitized copy without active content (CDR).
classification: Zero-Phishing is browser protection, URL Filtering is web filtering, Sandbox + CDR is the sandbox class.
